verse.verse_1: The Hour hath drawn nigh, and the moon hath been rent in sunder.. And if they behold a sign, they turn away and say: magic continuous.
verse.verse_2: And if they behold a sign, they turn away and say: "magic continous"
verse.verse_3: And they belied, and they followed their lusts; and every affair cometh to a final goal.
verse.verse_4: And assuredly there hath come Unto them tidings wherein is a deterrent.
verse.verse_5: Wisdom consummate. But warnings avail not.
verse.verse_6: Wherefore withdrew thou from them. The Day whereon the sum- moner Will summon mankind Unto a thing unpleasant.
verse.verse_7: With looks downcast they will come forth, from the tombs, as though they were locusts scattered abroad.
verse.verse_8: Hastening toward the summoner. The infidels will say: this is a day diffrcult.
verse.verse_9: There belied before them the people of Nuh. So they belied Our bondman Nuh and said: `a madman;' and moreover he was reproven.
verse.verse_10: Thereupon he prayed Unto his Lord: verily am overcome, so vindicate me.
verse.verse_11: Then We opened the portals of heaven with water poured out.
verse.verse_12: And We made the earth break forth with springs; SO that the water met for an affair already decreed.
verse.verse_13: And We bare him on a thing of planks and nails.
verse.verse_14: Moving forward under Our eyes: a requital for him who had been rejected.
verse.verse_15: And assuredly We left it for a sign. Is there then anyone who would be admonished?
verse.verse_16: So how dreadful have been My torment and My warning!
verse.verse_17: And assuredly We have made the Qur'an easy for admonition; is there then any one who would be admonished?
verse.verse_18: And there belied the 'A-ad; so how dreadful have been My torment and warning!
verse.verse_19: Verily We! We sent against them a raging Wind On a day of calamity continuous.
verse.verse_20: Carrying men away as though they were trunks of palm-trees uprooted.
verse.verse_21: So how dreodful have been My torment and My warning.
verse.verse_22: And assuredly We have made the Qur'an easy for admonition; is therethen any one who would be admonished!
verse.verse_23: And the Thamud belied the warnings.
verse.verse_24: And they said: a mere humanbeing from amongst us, and single! shall we follow him! verily then we should fall in error and madness.
verse.verse_25: Hath the Admonition been laid upon him from amongst us! Aye! he is a liar insolent.
verse.verse_26: They shall know tomorrow whichsoever is a liar insolent.
verse.verse_27: Verify We are sending the she-camel as a test for them, so watch them thou and have patience.
verse.verse_28: And declare thou Unto them that water hath been divided between them; every drinking shall be by turns.
verse.verse_29: Then they called their fellow, and he took the sword and hamstrung her,
verse.verse_30: So how dreadful have been My torment and My warnings.
verse.verse_31: Verily We We sent upon them one shout, and they became as the stubble of a fold-builder.
verse.verse_32: And assuredly We have made the Qur'an eary for admanirion: is there then any one who would be admonished.
verse.verse_33: The people of Lut belied the warnings.
verse.verse_34: Verily We! We sent upon them a gravel-storm save the household of Lut; them We delivered at early dawn.
verse.verse_35: As a favour from us. Thus We recompense him who giveth thanks.
verse.verse_36: And assuredly he had warned them of Our grasp, but: they doubted the warnings.
verse.verse_37: And assuredly they solicited him for his guests: then We wiped out their eyes: taste then My torment and My warnings.
verse.verse_38: And assuredly there met them early in the morning a torment settled.
verse.verse_39: Taste then My torment and My warnings.
verse.verse_40: And assuredly We have made the Qur'an easy for admonition; is there then any one who would be admonished.
verse.verse_41: And assuredly Unto the household of Fir'awn came the warning.
verse.verse_42: They belied Our signs everyone thereof; whereof We laid hold of them with the grip of our Mighty, Powerful.
verse.verse_43: Are your infidels better than these? Or is there an immunity for you in the Writs?
verse.verse_44: Or is it that they say: we are a multitude prevailing!
verse.verse_45: Anon will their multitude be vanquished, and they will turn the back.
verse.verse_46: Aye! the Hour is their appointed term, and the Hour shall be far more grievous and far more bitter.
verse.verse_47: Verily the culprits shall be in great error and madness.
verse.verse_48: On the Day whereon they shall be dragged into the Fire upon their faces, it shall be said Unto them: taste the touch of the Scorching.
verse.verse_49: Veriiy everything! We have created it by a measure.
verse.verse_50: And Our commandment shall be but one, as the twinkling of an eye.
verse.verse_51: And assuredly We have destroyed your likes; so is there any one who shall be admonished?
verse.verse_52: And everything they have wrought is in the Writs.
verse.verse_53: And everything, small and great, hath been written down.
verse.verse_54: Verily the God-fearing will be in Gardens and among rivers.
verse.verse_55: In a good seat, near a Sovereign Omnipotent.
